metas.name: Lenin Pandiyan
metas.description: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district. By the orders from a steadfast judge, to ensure protection & safeguard them from the vindictive political system, they nominate a weakest unassuming rookie police constable .The emotional bond between the rookie policeman and the couple & how they avenge the entrenched political system with fortuitous incidents as a new found allies forms the rest of the narrative.

metas.name: Pulp Fiction
metas.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.
Two high school sweethearts meet at a reunion after 22 years and reminisce about their past.

metas.name: Sonar Kella
metas.description: A young boy becomes a target for crooks, after he claims to remember his past life and mentions precious jewels in a golden fortress.

metas.name: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
metas.description: The truth behind the ascension of Milkha Singh, who was scarred by of the India-Pakistan partition.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: Seven years after burying a dark secret, a cinema owner and his family face a renewed investigation led by a relentless new inspector and a grieving mother. New witnesses and forensic traps threaten to shatter their peaceful life.

metas.name: Khosla Ka Ghosla!
metas.description: A Delhi-based retired middle-class man tries half-heartedly to get his land back from a swindling property dealer with the help of his sons and their friends.

metas.name: Anand
metas.description: The story of a terminally ill man who wishes to live life to the fullest before the inevitable occurs, as told by his best friend.

metas.name: Wild Tales
metas.description: Six short stories that explore the extremities of human behavior involving people in distress.

metas.name: The Exorcist
metas.description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

metas.name: Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1
metas.description: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

metas.name: Evaru
metas.description: Sub-inspector Vikram Vasudev is entrusted with the task of investigating the murder of a high ranking officer who was killed by his alleged rape victim. When he delves deeper into the case he uncovers some surprising facts.

metas.name: Rush
metas.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

metas.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

metas.name: Andaz Apna Apna
metas.description: Two slackers competing for the affections of an heiress inadvertently become her protectors from an evil criminal.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Memories
metas.description: Sam Alex, a drunkard ex-cop, is forced to investigate a series of murders which are committed in the same pattern. His search leads to a serial killer, and something more than what he expected.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: Paul Atreides arrives on Arrakis after his father accepts the stewardship of the dangerous planet. However, chaos ensues after a betrayal as forces clash to control melange, a precious resource.

metas.name: Rosemary's Baby
metas.description: A young woman suspects her neighbors have sinister plans for her pregnancy.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A young aristocrat falls in love with a poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

metas.name: Vishwaroopam
metas.description: A nuclear oncologist's simple investigation into her husband's daily routine as a dance teacher spirals into a complex web of revelations about his true identity.

metas.name: Gully Boy
metas.description: A coming-of-age story based on the lives of street rappers in Mumbai.

metas.name: Badhaai Ho
metas.description: A man is embarrassed when he finds out his mother is pregnant.

metas.name: Manam
metas.description: Through reincarnation, family members are able to cross generations and meddle in each others' lives.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: Two brothers in 1910s California struggle to maintain the favor of their affectionate but strict, Bible-toting father as an old secret about their long-absent mother comes to light.

metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: Karwaan
metas.description: Two friends and a chirpy teenager take a road trip from Bangalore to Kochi.

metas.name: Raanjhanaa
metas.description: Kundan, the son of a Hindu pundit, discovers that his childhood sweetheart Zoya loves city-bred Akram and wants to marry him. However, he persistently seeks to win her heart.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Sharmaji Namkeen
metas.description: A light-hearted coming-of-age story of a lovable 60-year-old-man.

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.
On June 25, 1983, the Lord's Cricket Ground witnessed 14 men beat the two times World Champions West Indies, putting India back onto the cricket world stage.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
metas.description: Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
metas.description: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

metas.name: Gupt: The Hidden Truth
metas.description: Governor Jaisingh Sinha is murdered and the needle of suspicion points towards his estranged son, Sahil Sinha who must prove his innocence.

metas.name: Maine Pyar Kiya
metas.description: After Suman's father leaves her in the care of another family while he travels abroad, she falls in love with Prem. However, in order to for them to marry, Prem has to prove to Suman's father that he is not the same as his own dad.

metas.name: Mardaani 2
metas.description: A 21-year old boy Sunny has a penchant for sexually assaulting and killing girls. He's locked horns with top cop Shivani Shivaji Roy. Will she nab him?

metas.name: Talaash: The Answer Lies Within
metas.description: Inspector Surjan Shekhawat, who is dealing with a depressing past, has to investigate a high profile murder case, deal with his crumbling marriage and use the help and solace of a prostitute by the name of Rosie.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.
